title: AI headshot generator: 10 selfies to 40 LinkedIn headshots for $29

source.text: An AI headshot generator: upload 10 selfies, get 40 professional LinkedIn headshots for $29. Launch country US, budget $2,000, 10 hours a week, goal side income, edge: I am a developer. Just go: do not ask questions. Use the slug ai-headshots.

problem: Professionals need a polished LinkedIn headshot without paying for a photographer.
customer: US professionals and job seekers updating their LinkedIn profile
solution: Web app: upload 10 selfies, a fine-tuned image model returns 40 professional headshots.
claims: upload 10 selfies, get 40 professional LinkedIn headshots for $29
assumptions: No existing audience, list or customers in the niche (not stated; user said 'just go')
No validation done yet (no waitlist, no pre-sales)
Generation runs on a hosted model API (fal.ai / Replicate / Astria), not own GPUs
Stripe for payments at US standard fees (2.9% + $0.30, not verified on a US page)
